repairs: Missing/invalid scores remain unavailable; genuine zero is preserved. Missing weights have a specific explanation.
Stale responses clear previous measurements and analog matches; fresh responses clear the error banner.
Historical lines and filled areas break across missing observations; one-point charts remain finite.
No automatic commentary request or unvalidated investment instruction. The separate companion remains inspectable.
Named economic quote bases; WI tails unavailable without a same-security quote; bill discount rates/TIPS/FRNs excluded from nominal benchmark comparisons.
Indicator labels distinguish indirect bidders from foreign flows, issuance per auction day from net liquidity, and heuristics from validated performance.
Provider values escaped/formatted before tenor/anchor/trigger markup; missing numeric values not coerced to zero.
Neutral unavailable styling; mobile overflow repaired; keyboard-focusable scroll regions preserve every table column.

browser.scope: Isolated exact HTML/CSS and renderer with explicit synthetic fixtures. Other site addons removed; CSP blocks external fetches. No live engine or consumer packet read.

limitations: No native measurement publication, provider completeness, original-source replay, predictive edge, historical point-in-time validity or portfolio authority is claimed.
Legacy FRED clocks, forward-calendar identities, fixed historical heuristic thresholds and selected analogs still require engine repair.

static_acceptance.scope: Whole static HTML/scripts/generated registry transport only. No browser execution or current consumer packet request.
